title: Conversation 2026-11-27: AI outputs people can open and check — planning the protocol and governance-product holon

sections.name: summary
sections.label: Summary
sections.content: Review of the day's protocol and Blueprint research and its three implementations (LTH Works minutes, the Party Utility backstage, LiveWyer Insight), the off-protocol update passes on the backstage, and the strata design; then a planning brief and a holon for an AI-made document a person can read as a summary and open down to its evidence, kept consistent over time. The first product in it is structured governance (minutes with provenance).
